beats.say: Indonesia is wider than the United States.
beats.title: INDONESIA IS WIDER THAN THE USA

beats.say: From one end to the other, it spans more than five thousand kilometers.
Drop it on top of America, at true size.
It runs from the Pacific coast past the Atlantic shore.
It's made of more than seventeen thousand islands, and it's home to about two hundred eighty million people. The fourth biggest population in the world.
A country most people can't picture, bigger than they think. Follow for more.
beats.title: BIGGER THAN YOU THINK
